title: David’s Mighty Men and Army

questions.question: Where was David when men came to him while he was restricted because of Saul?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:1 (ESV): "Now these are the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he could not move about freely because of Saul..."

questions.question: What skill did the Benjaminites have?
options: They could shoot arrows and sling stones with either the right or the left hand
questions.correctAnswer: They could shoot arrows and sling stones with either the right or the left hand
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:2 (ESV): "...they could shoot arrows and sling stones with either the right or the left hand..."

questions.question: Who was chief of the men of Gad?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:9 (ESV): "Ezer the chief, Obadiah second, Eliab third,"

questions.question: How many days were they with David, eating and drinking?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:39 (ESV): "And they were there with David for three days, eating and drinking..."

questions.question: What characterized the men of Issachar?
options: They had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do
questions.correctAnswer: They had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:32 (ESV): "Of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do..."

questions.question: Who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:15 (ESV): "These are the men who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it was overflowing all its banks..." Context refers to Gadites (v8).

questions.question: What did the Spirit clothe Amasai to say?
options: We are yours, O David, and with you, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers!
questions.correctAnswer: We are yours, O David, and with you, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers!
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:18 (ESV): "Then the Spirit clothed Amasai... and he said, 'We are yours, O David... Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers...'"

questions.question: Who joined David when he went with the Philistines against Saul?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:19 (ESV): "Some of the men of Manasseh deserted to David when he came with the Philistines for the battle against Saul."

questions.question: How many from Zebulun came to Hebron?
Why did all these men of war come to Hebron?
options: To make David king over all Israel
questions.correctAnswer: To make David king over all Israel
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:38 (ESV): "...came to Hebron with a whole heart to make David king over all Israel."

questions.question: Who brought food on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:40 (ESV): "And also their relatives... from Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought food on donkeys and camels and mules and oxen..."

questions.question: Who was leader of the house of Aaron?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:27 (ESV): "Jehoiada, leader of the house of Aaron..."

questions.question: How many from the tribe of Levi came?
What description is given of the Gadites' faces?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:8 (ESV): "...whose faces were like the faces of lions..."

questions.question: How many commanders were from Benjamin?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:29 (ESV): "Of the Benjaminites, the kinsmen of Saul, 3,000..."

key_verse_text: All these, men of war, arrayed in battle order, came to Hebron with a whole heart to make David king over all Israel. Likewise, all the rest of Israel were of a single mind to make David king.
